description: Backend server implementation for a conversation analysis application using FastAPI, MongoDB, and AI models. Handles session management, message analysis, re-evaluation, and transcription.

classes.name: AvatarConfig
classes.description: Pydantic model for avatar configuration including gender, skin tone, hair style, facial features.

classes.name: ConversationMessage
classes.description: Pydantic model for individual conversation messages with speaker, text, timestamp, and detected patterns.

classes.name: SessionCreate
classes.description: Pydantic model for creating a new session with avatars and user names.

classes.name: AnalyzeRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model for analyzing a message within a session.

classes.name: ReEvaluateRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model for re-evaluating patterns with additional conversation context.

methods.name: read_root
methods.description: Health check endpoint returning a simple message.

methods.name: create_session
methods.description: Creates a new conversation session in the database.

methods.name: get_session
methods.description: Retrieves session data, optionally including messages.

methods.name: transcribe_audio
methods.description: Handles audio file upload and transcribes speech to text using OpenAI Whisper.

methods.name: analyze_message
methods.description: Analyzes a message for communication patterns using AI, stores results.

methods.name: reevaluate_patterns
methods.description: Re-evaluates tentative patterns with additional context, updates database.

methods.name: get_messages
methods.description: Retrieves paginated messages for a session.
